beginner.summary: For JavaScript developers and freshers starting back-end work. Covers the Node.js runtime and tooling, JavaScript for the server, CommonJS and ES modules, npm, the event loop and async code, files, streams and buffers, events and configuration, the http module, REST APIs with Express, middleware and errors, request validation, databases with Prisma, password hashing and JWT, calling other APIs, testing with the built-in test runner, logging and debugging, command-line tools and running Node.js in containers.
prerequisites: Knows JavaScript variables, functions, arrays and objects
Comfortable with a terminal and Git
Understands HTTP requests and JSON at a basic level
outcomes: Build REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Write correct asynchronous code with promises and streams
Store data, secure endpoints and test APIs
Debug, log and ship a Node.js service in a container

days.topic: Node.js Overview, Installation and Tooling Setup
subtopics: What Node.js is: V8, libuv and the standard library
Where Node.js fits: APIs, real-time services, tools and serverless
Installing Node.js with a version manager (nvm or fnm)
npm, npx and alternatives such as pnpm
days.lab_task: Install two Node.js versions with a version manager, switch between them, write a script that prints system information, run it in watch mode and load settings from a .env file.
days.deliverable: Working toolchain and a first script in a Git repository
checks: Script restarts automatically after a save
Script prints the value from the file

days.topic: JavaScript Essentials for Node.js Developers
subtopics: Array methods: map, filter, reduce and find
days.lab_task: Refactor a 200-line legacy script into modern JavaScript with const, arrow functions, destructuring and array methods, and fix every ESLint warning.
days.deliverable: Refactored script with lint report
checks: Correct value of this predicted in five snippets

days.topic: Modules: CommonJS and ES Modules
subtopics: Importing JSON and built-in node: modules
Mixing CommonJS and ES modules safely
days.lab_task: Split a single-file program into ES modules with named and default exports, import a CommonJS library from ES module code and load a plugin with dynamic import().
days.deliverable: Modular project with a short note on module choices
checks: Same output as the single file
Package works from ES module code
Plugin chosen at runtime is loaded

days.topic: npm, package.json and Dependency Management
days.lab_task: Create a project with runtime and development dependencies, add build, test and lint scripts, reproduce an install from the lock file with npm ci, and fix the vulnerabilities npm audit reports.
days.deliverable: Project with scripts, lock file and audit notes
checks: Build, test and lint scripts all succeed
No high or critical vulnerabilities remain

days.topic: The Event Loop, Callbacks, Promises and async/await
subtopics: Event loop phases at a high level
Unhandled rejections and how to avoid them
days.lab_task: Convert a callback-based file processor to async/await, run independent requests in parallel with Promise.all, show how a blocking loop delays timers and fix an unhandled rejection.
days.deliverable: Refactored processor and an event loop experiment write-up
checks: Total time close to the slowest request
Timer fires late while the loop blocks

days.topic: Working with Files and Paths
subtopics: fs/promises for reading and writing files
Handling missing files and permissions errors
days.lab_task: Build a script that walks a folder tree, reports file counts and sizes by extension, writes the report as JSON and CSV, and handles missing and unreadable files without crashing.
days.deliverable: Folder report script with sample outputs
checks: Totals match du or Explorer for the folder
JSON and CSV files contain the same totals
Clear error message for a missing folder

days.topic: Streams and Buffers
subtopics: Readable, writable, duplex and transform streams
Reading large files line by line
Choosing streams over reading whole files
days.lab_task: Process a 2 GB log file with streams to count errors per hour, gzip the output on the fly and compare memory use with a version that reads the whole file.
days.deliverable: Streaming processor and memory comparison
checks: Stream version stays under 100 MB of memory
Gzip output decompresses to the expected content
objectives: Process large data with low memory

days.topic: Events, Process and Environment Configuration
subtopics: The process object: argv, env and exit codes
days.lab_task: Build a job runner that emits progress events, reads settings from the environment with validation, refuses to start with missing settings and exits cleanly on SIGINT.
days.deliverable: Job runner with configuration module
checks: Runner exits with a clear message and non-zero code
Runner finishes the current job and exits cleanly

days.topic: Building an HTTP Server with the http Module
subtopics: How an HTTP request and response work
Reading the method, URL and headers
days.lab_task: Build a small JSON API with the http module only, with GET, POST and DELETE routes, correct status codes, JSON body parsing and static file serving.
days.deliverable: HTTP server and a list of pain points for frameworks to solve
checks: Correct status codes for success and errors
File downloads with the correct content type
objectives: Build a server without a framework

days.topic: REST APIs with Express
subtopics: REST conventions for resources and verbs
Testing endpoints with an HTTP client

days.deliverable: Books API and HTTP client collection

days.deliverable: API with middleware and an error format document
checks: Central handler returns a JSON error
Each request logged with its ID and duration

days.topic: Validating Requests with Zod
subtopics: Zod schemas for body, params and query
Sharing schemas with the front end
days.lab_task: Add Zod validation to every books API endpoint with a reusable middleware, return field-level error messages and share the schemas with a small front-end form.
days.deliverable: Validated API and shared schema package
checks: 400 with a message for each bad field
Front-end form uses the same schema

days.topic: Persisting Data with Prisma and PostgreSQL
days.lab_task: Move the books API from memory to PostgreSQL with Prisma, create migrations, add author relations, paginate results and seed sample data.
days.deliverable: Database-backed API with migrations and seed script
checks: Tables created from the Prisma schema
Page size and next page links correct
Book and author saved together or not at all

days.topic: Password Hashing, JWT and Protected Routes
subtopics: Storing passwords with bcrypt or argon2
Token expiry and refresh in brief

days.deliverable: Authenticated API and security notes
checks: 401 without a token and success with one

days.topic: Calling External APIs with fetch
subtopics: Wrapping an API in a client module
days.lab_task: Build a client module for a public weather API with timeouts, retries with backoff, error handling and a short in-memory cache, and use it from an API endpoint.
days.deliverable: API client module with tests
checks: Client retries and then returns a clear error

days.topic: Testing with the Node.js Test Runner and Supertest
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the services and HTTP tests for every API route with Supertest against a test database, mock the weather client and reach 80 percent coverage.
days.deliverable: Test suite with coverage report
checks: Line coverage of 80 percent or more
Tests pass with the network disconnected

days.topic: Logging and Debugging Node.js Applications
subtopics: Pino log levels and JSON logs
Debugging in VS Code with breakpoints
Not logging secrets and personal data
days.lab_task: Replace console logging with Pino, add request IDs, redact passwords and tokens, then use the VS Code debugger to find and fix two planted bugs.
days.deliverable: Logging setup and bug fix notes
checks: Each line is JSON with a request ID
Passwords and tokens never appear in logs
Both bugs found with breakpoints and fixed

days.topic: Command-Line Tools with Node.js
subtopics: Shebang lines and bin entries in package.json
Reading from stdin and writing to stdout
Publishing a CLI to a private registry
days.lab_task: Build a CLI that imports a CSV of books into the API with options for dry run and batch size, progress output, correct exit codes and tests.
days.deliverable: Installable CLI with README
checks: No data changed and a summary printed
Non-zero exit code with a helpful message

days.topic: Packaging and Running Node.js in Production with Docker
days.lab_task: Containerise the API with a multi-stage Dockerfile, run it as a non-root user with PostgreSQL in Docker Compose, add a health check and prove in-flight requests finish on shutdown.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, Compose file and run guide
checks: Image under 200 MB running as non-root
API and database start and pass health checks

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Task Management REST API
days.lab_task: Build a task management API with users, projects and tasks, validation, JWT authentication, pagination, logging, tests and a Docker Compose setup, then demo it to the group.
days.deliverable: Repository, API collection and demo recording
checks: All features work from the collection
Suite passes in CI or locally with coverage
docker compose up runs the full stack

intermediate.summary: For developers who already build Node.js APIs. Covers TypeScript for services, layered architecture, Fastify, NestJS, OpenAPI documentation, database transactions and pools, Mongoose in production, Redis caching, BullMQ jobs, Socket.IO, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, OWASP risks, worker threads, stream backpressure, integration testing with containers, observability with OpenTelemetry, profiling and memory leaks, GraphQL with Apollo Server and CI/CD.
prerequisites: Has built a REST API with Express or a similar framework
outcomes: Design maintainable Node.js services with TypeScript and clear layers
Use Fastify or NestJS with caching, queues and real-time features
Secure, observe and profile services in production
Test and deliver services through CI/CD

days.topic: TypeScript for Node.js Services
subtopics: Running TypeScript with tsx or type stripping
ES module output and path aliases
days.lab_task: Migrate the books API to TypeScript with strict mode, typed handlers and configuration, run it in development without a build step and ship a compiled build.
days.deliverable: TypeScript service with build scripts
checks: tsc reports no errors in strict mode
Service starts directly from TypeScript in development
Compiled output runs in the container

days.topic: Project Structure and Layered Architecture for Node.js APIs
days.lab_task: Restructure an API into feature modules with controllers, services and repositories, inject dependencies at a composition root and enforce layer boundaries with lint rules.
days.deliverable: Restructured service and architecture decision record
checks: Lint fails when a controller imports a repository

Domain errors become correct HTTP codes

days.deliverable: Fastify service and benchmark report
checks: Invalid requests rejected by the schema

Requests per second compared for both frameworks

days.topic: NestJS Modules, Providers and Dependency Injection
subtopics: NestJS architecture: modules, controllers and providers

days.deliverable: NestJS service with tests
checks: Protect a route with a guard
Invalid bodies rejected with field errors

days.topic: API Documentation with OpenAPI
days.lab_task: Produce an OpenAPI document for the service from its schemas, publish it with Swagger UI, generate a typed client, and fail CI when the implementation breaks the contract.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI document, docs site and generated client
checks: Typed client compiles and calls the API
CI fails on the contract check

days.topic: Database Transactions, Migrations and Connection Pools
subtopics: Migrations in teams and in CI
days.lab_task: Fix an N+1 query, tune the connection pool under load, run a zero-downtime column rename in three migrations and use a transaction for a money transfer with correct isolation.
days.deliverable: Database improvements with before and after measurements
checks: Query count drops for the list endpoint
No pool timeouts at the target load
Balances stay correct under concurrent transfers

Place an order in a transaction
Concurrent edit rejected with a version error

days.topic: Caching with Redis
subtopics: When to cache and what to cache
days.lab_task: Add cache-aside caching for the most expensive endpoint, invalidate on writes, protect against stampedes, add ETags and measure latency and hit rate under load.
days.deliverable: Cached service with measurements
checks: p95 latency lower with the cache
Only one request rebuilds the cache entry

subtopics: Why work moves to background jobs
days.lab_task: Move email sending and report generation to BullMQ workers with retries, a repeatable nightly job and a failed-jobs view, and show the API stays fast during heavy job load.
days.deliverable: Queue setup with workers and dashboard
checks: Job retries with backoff and lands in failed after the limit
Nightly job runs at the set time
API latency unchanged while workers are busy

days.topic: Socket.IO Rooms, Namespaces and Scaling
subtopics: Sticky sessions behind a load balancer
Server-sent events as a simpler option
days.lab_task: Build live order status updates with Socket.IO rooms per customer, authenticate connections with JWT, run three instances behind NGINX with the Redis adapter and test reconnection.
days.deliverable: Real-time service with scaling notes
checks: Customers receive only their own updates
Messages reach clients on every instance
Client reconnects and receives missed updates

days.topic: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect in Node.js
subtopics: Using an identity provider: Keycloak, Auth0 or Entra ID
days.lab_task: Protect the API with tokens from an identity provider, validate signatures with JWKS, enforce scopes per route, and add a client credentials flow for a partner integration.
days.deliverable: Protected API and integration guide
checks: Request accepted with the right scope
Use a token for another audience

days.topic: Securing Node.js APIs Against the OWASP Top 10
subtopics: Broken access control and object-level checks
Injection in SQL, NoSQL and shell commands
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted vulnerabilities in a sample API: an IDOR, a NoSQL injection, an SSRF, prototype pollution and a slow regular expression, then add Semgrep and ZAP to CI.
days.deliverable: Vulnerability fixes and security pipeline
checks: Users cannot read other users' orders
Pipeline fails on a new high finding

days.topic: Worker Threads and CPU-Bound Work
subtopics: Why CPU work blocks the event loop
Offloading to queues or other services
days.lab_task: Measure event loop delay while an endpoint resizes images, move the work to a Piscina pool and show latency for other endpoints returns to normal.
days.deliverable: Worker pool implementation and measurements
checks: Delay spikes recorded before the change
Other endpoints stay fast during image work
Throughput compared for three pool sizes
objectives: Choose between threads, processes and queues

days.topic: Streams in Depth: Backpressure and Pipelines
days.lab_task: Stream a large CSV upload through validation and transformation into the database without buffering, handle a broken row and stream a large export back to the client.
days.deliverable: Streaming import and export endpoints
checks: Memory stays flat during the upload
Pipeline stops cleanly with an error report
Download starts before the query finishes

days.topic: Integration Testing with Testcontainers and Mocks
subtopics: Testcontainers for PostgreSQL, Redis and MongoDB
Mocking HTTP with MSW or nock
days.lab_task: Write integration tests that start PostgreSQL and Redis containers, mock a payment provider, run in parallel safely and produce a JUnit report for CI.
days.deliverable: Integration test suite and CI report
checks: Tests pass against real PostgreSQL and Redis
No shared-state failures across ten runs

days.topic: Observability with Pino, OpenTelemetry and Metrics
days.lab_task: Instrument the service with OpenTelemetry traces across HTTP, database and queue calls, add Prometheus metrics, link logs to trace IDs and build a Grafana dashboard with an alert.
days.deliverable: Instrumented service and dashboard
checks: Single trace shows HTTP, database and queue spans
Log lines carry the trace ID
Alert triggers on high error rate

days.topic: Performance Profiling: Flame Graphs and Memory Leaks
subtopics: Load testing with autocannon or k6
Common leak sources: caches, listeners and closures
days.lab_task: Load test a slow endpoint, find the hot function in a flame graph, find a memory leak with heap snapshot comparison, fix both and prove the gains.
days.deliverable: Profiling report with before and after results
checks: Hot function identified in the flame graph
Higher throughput and flat memory over 30 minutes

days.topic: GraphQL APIs with Apollo Server

days.deliverable: GraphQL service with generated types

days.topic: CI/CD for Node.js Services
subtopics: Pipeline stages: install, lint, test and build

days.deliverable: Pipeline definition and release notes
checks: All stages pass on a pull request
Matrix shows both Node.js versions passing
Previous version restored from the pipeline

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Order Service
days.lab_task: Build an order service with TypeScript, OpenAPI docs, transactions, caching, background jobs, real-time status updates, OAuth protection, tests with containers, tracing and a CI/CD pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, dashboards and presentation
checks: Orders flow from creation to live status updates

advanced.summary: For senior Node.js engineers and technical leads. Covers Node.js internals, microservice boundaries, event-driven services with Kafka and RabbitMQ, scaling and statelessness, resilience patterns, supply chain security and the permission model, multi-tenant APIs, serverless Node.js, Node.js on Kubernetes, native addons and WebAssembly, advanced diagnostics, HTTP/2 and gRPC, data-intensive processing, federated GraphQL and BFFs, monorepos, runtime choices, large upgrades, incident troubleshooting and architecture leadership.
prerequisites: Several years building production Node.js services
Comfortable with TypeScript, databases and containers
Has worked with queues or distributed systems
outcomes: Design and scale distributed Node.js systems
Diagnose deep performance and reliability problems
Secure the Node.js supply chain and runtime
Lead architecture and upgrade decisions for Node.js teams

days.topic: Node.js Internals: V8, libuv and Event Loop Phases
subtopics: V8 compilation tiers and hidden classes
Garbage collection: young and old generations
libuv thread pool and which APIs use it
days.lab_task: Predict and verify execution order in ten tricky async snippets, starve the libuv thread pool with crypto work and fix it, and find a deoptimisation with V8 tracing.
days.deliverable: Internals lab notebook with explanations
checks: At least nine of ten orders predicted correctly
DNS and file calls slow until the pool is resized

days.topic: Microservices with Node.js: Boundaries and Communication

When a modular monolith is better
days.lab_task: Split an order monolith into order, payment and inventory services with clear data ownership, implement a saga for checkout and compare it with the modular monolith version.
days.deliverable: Service map, saga implementation and comparison
checks: No service reads another service's database
Latency and complexity compared with the monolith

subtopics: KafkaJS or Confluent clients for Node.js

days.deliverable: Event-driven services with an event catalogue
checks: Consumers produce no duplicates after replay
Message reaches the dead letter queue after retries
Old and new consumers both keep working

days.topic: Scaling Node.js: Clustering, Load Balancing and Statelessness

HTTP agent and connection reuse with undici

days.deliverable: Capacity model and scaling configuration

days.topic: Resilience Patterns: Timeouts, Retries, Circuit Breakers and Bulkheads
days.lab_task: Inject latency and errors into a dependency with Toxiproxy, add timeouts, retry budgets, a circuit breaker and a bulkhead, and show the service degrades gracefully instead of failing.
days.deliverable: Resilience changes with chaos test results
checks: Requests time out at the configured limit

Secrets from a vault at runtime

days.deliverable: Supply chain policy, SBOM and hardened run configuration

Access outside allowed paths is denied

days.deliverable: Multi-tenant API and isolation test suite
checks: Tenant A never sees tenant B data in any endpoint

subtopics: When native code is worth it

days.lab_task: Build a gRPC service with unary and server-streaming calls, enforce deadlines, call it from a Python client and compare it with a REST version for latency and payload size.
